nodes.name: Verificação Periódica
nodes.notes: Agente Orquestrador - Executa a cada 15 minutos

parameters.query:
=SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_connections,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'active') as active_connections,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'idle') as idle_connections
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE datname = 'postgres';

=INSERT INTO troubleshooting_reports (
  id,
  timestamp,
  specialist_type,
  issues,
  diagnosis,
  action_plan,
  severity,
  status,
  created_at
) VALUES (
  gen_random_uuid(),
  '{{ $json.timestamp }}',
  'orchestrator',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.issues) }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ JSON.stringify({ summary: $json.summary, agentAnalyses: $json.agentAnalyses }) }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.consolidatedActionPlan) }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ $json.issues.some(i => i.severity === "critical") ? "critical" : "medium" }}',
  'pending_approval',
  NOW()
) RETURNING id, timestamp, status;
